later_revalidation: After this phase the workflow changed three times in phase 12: stage-frame comments (attempt 1), the Cut1 columnList (attempt 2), and the output labels (attempt 3). Each change was re-validated with the same gxwf validate --strict --connections command, exit 0, 20 of 20 tool steps ok, connections valid. See model-test-log.md.

tool_state.note: Resolved from the populated tool cache. --strict forbids skipped checks, and no step was skipped.

connections.note: --connections checks collection algebra and map-over, including the when inputs (mapped per element) and the MultiQC repeat reduction. This is a design-time model, not Galaxy's scheduler.

companion_tests.recorded_in: phase 10; the file has not changed since that run

residual_runtime_risks.risk: 20 steps pin Tool Shed changesets (devteam fastqc 0.74+galaxy1, samtools_flagstat 2.0.8, samtools_idxstats 2.0.8, samtools_sort 2.0.8, samtools_stats 2.0.9; iuc samtools_fastx 1.22+galaxy2 and multiqc 1.35+galaxy5; bgruening fastq_info 0.25.3+galaxy0) and stock tools (Grep1 1.0.4, Cut1 1.0.2, param_value_from_file 0.1.0, __FILTER_NULL__ 1.1.0, __ZIP_COLLECTION__ 1.0.0, __FLATTEN__ 1.0.0, __MERGE_COLLECTION__ 1.0.0). Validation read cached metadata, not installed tools.
residual_runtime_risks.why_static_cannot_settle: The cache holds tool summaries. It does not show that each changeset installs and runs under Planemo.
residual_runtime_risks.proving_artifact: Phase 12 planemo run: job states and invocation_details messages in tool_test_output.json.

residual_runtime_risks.risk: No BAM index is staged for any element, and v1 takes no index input. samtools_idxstats may need a .bai.
residual_runtime_risks.why_static_cannot_settle: The port is wired. Whether the wrapper indexes internally is a runtime question.
residual_runtime_risks.proving_artifact: Phase 12 samtools_idxstats job state and the low-confidence idxstats checksums in the test file.

residual_runtime_risks.risk: paired_name_sort and paired_fastx run when paired_count > 0, and single_collate and single_fastx when paired_count === 0. paired_count is a per-sample integer. The connection checker maps the when inputs per element, but Galaxy's runtime evaluation of a mapped when is not verified.
residual_runtime_risks.why_static_cannot_settle: The checker models the gate; it does not run Galaxy's scheduler.
residual_runtime_risks.proving_artifact: Phase 12 element membership: reads_paired holds test and test2 (no_bai-mixed reads_single holds test3), plus any when_not_boolean or expression_evaluation_failed message in invocation_details.

residual_runtime_risks.risk: reads_single comes from the gated single-end chain. In default-paired that chain is skipped for every sample, so the output may be unregistered (workflow_output_not_found) or empty, while the test expects element_count 0.
residual_runtime_risks.why_static_cannot_settle: Output registration depends on the scheduler's handling of skipped steps.
residual_runtime_risks.proving_artifact: Phase 12 default-paired output problems and invocation messages with reason workflow_output_not_found.

residual_runtime_risks.risk: reads_paired depends on samtools_fastx pairing name-sorted reads (read numbering -N; 256 and 2048 excluded; singletons not exported). Line counts assume complete pairs.
residual_runtime_risks.why_static_cannot_settle: Pairing is the tool's behaviour on the data.
residual_runtime_risks.proving_artifact: Phase 12 has_n_lines on the forward and reverse elements: 11284 (test), 10872 (test2), 49892 (test3, single-end).

residual_runtime_risks.risk: MultiQC receives FastQC outputs (results_0) and samtools outputs (results_1) through repeat instances with reduction. The checker validates the wiring, not how MultiQC handles the collections.
residual_runtime_risks.why_static_cannot_settle: Repeat handling is a wrapper runtime behaviour.
residual_runtime_risks.proving_artifact: Phase 12 multiqc job state and the multiqc_report output (existence and type only).

residual_runtime_risks.risk: Read elements are <sample>_forward and <sample>_reverse after __FLATTEN__ (join _), with forward and reverse sub-elements in reads_paired. The source names them _1 and _2 (post_conversion_1 and _2 for FastQC). Identity assertions use the Galaxy names.
residual_runtime_risks.why_static_cannot_settle: The names are decided by the tools at runtime.
residual_runtime_risks.proving_artifact: Phase 12 element identity on fastqc_post_conversion_html, fastqutils_info and reads_paired.

residual_runtime_risks.risk: The flagstat and idxstats checksums are upstream nf-test tokens. A mismatch can come from the wrapper's output bytes, not the workflow. The stats check uses has_text on the raw total sequences key, whose format is unverified.
residual_runtime_risks.why_static_cannot_settle: Output bytes exist only after a run.
residual_runtime_risks.proving_artifact: Phase 12 checksum and has_text results. Any mismatch is reported as a finding; the expected value is not changed.

residual_runtime_risks.risk: The three BAM inputs come from GitHub raw URLs. The SHA-1 hashes were computed by nextflow-to-test-data from those files, so the check depends on the remote bytes being unchanged.
residual_runtime_risks.why_static_cannot_settle: Remote content is not checked by static validation.
residual_runtime_risks.proving_artifact: Phase 12 upload of the BAM inputs. Planemo reports any hash mismatch.
